verdict.rationale: Evidence only indirectly touches this axis: a community member describes porting react-bootstrap to SolidJS (implying no native equivalent existed and manual porting was needed), and another notes Solid lags behind React's ecosystem for popular libraries like framer-motion and trpc adapters. There's no first-party or independent evidence of a rich, mature catalog of pre-built third-party Solid UI component libraries comparable to other frameworks. Missing for 10: documentation or listing of established Solid-native UI component libraries, independent corroboration of ecosystem breadth/maturity, and confirmation these libraries are well-maintained rather than ports/adapters.
